name: PagerDuty: resolve on escalation closed
description: Whenever an escalation leaves pending (accepted, redirected, climbed, superseded, withdrawn or cancelled), resolve the matching PagerDuty incident using the same dedup key.

secrets.name: PAGERDUTY_ROUTING_KEY
secrets.description: PagerDuty Events API v2 integration (routing) key of the service that should be paged.

setup:
## PagerDuty side
Same integration key as *PagerDuty: page on case escalation*. Store it as `PAGERDUTY_ROUTING_KEY`, allowed host `events.pagerduty.com`.

## How it works
- Runs when an escalation closes (trigger `case.escalation_closed`): `POST https://events.pagerduty.com/v2/enqueue` with `event_action: resolve` and the escalation's `dedup_key`.


## Ack to accept
To let an acknowledgement in PagerDuty accept the escalation in SOC Hub, open **Settings → Integrations → Escalation paging**: the card shows the inbound URL to paste into PagerDuty (a Generic Webhooks (V3) subscription on the service, event *incident.acknowledged*). It is tied to this tenant.
